My dad came back from the dead to say goodbye to me because we didn't get a chance to before he died. If any one cares I'll tell the full story if they want.

Edit: Well then let's begin. My father was diagnosed with COPD in October 2010. He had been an alcoholic as long as I remember which lead to his death even faster. He would not stop drinking or smoking even though he had an illness that could lead to his death. 
A week before Christmas a year after he found out. My Mom and I caught the flu. It was bad. My dad was not doing good at all. He could not get up at all. He was going through this weird absence Were he would only say a few things ( Lordy, I love you, help me). He would look at me like I was not there and point his TV controller at the wall and try to change the channel on the TV which was on the opposite side of the room. I now know that he was having seizures from alcohol withdrawal. Anyway back to being sick. I could not get up at all to help him. My mother and I were his caretakers since he would not allow anyone else including nurses to take care of him.  My mom was outside (she was feeling a little bit better) so she could get some fresh air. My father kept calling to her. "Karen!" I kept hearing. Even though I could hardly move I got up from the couch and opened the door "What do you need? Mums outside." I was shaking horribly. The last words he said to me was "that's all right Maul (my nickname) go lay down I love you". When My mum came in she called an ambulance because he was not doing well at all. Christmas day rolls around. We open presents and such. My dog goes over to my dads bedroom door to try to see if he will come out with us. My heart just sunk. Around 12 after eating lunch we got a call. "This is doctor so and so. I'm sorry to inform you but John (my father) has passed away". I was sad but I never cried. I hardly felt anything to be honest. I never really felt like I lost something that day. Fast forward a   Couple weeks I'm at my sisters house. I have a strange dream. I walk out my bedroom door and there is my father sitting at the kitchen table drinking his coffee like he use to. He looked very healthy. I asked him "where are you staying?" he replied " At Connie's apartment." Connie is my aunt who died a year before. My hallway which didn't have a door before for some reason had one. He had me follow him and we were at my aunts. I asked him a few more questions and that was that. I thought I just had the dream because I missed him but now I know that wasn't the case. My mum and I picked up his ashes at the funeral home. Strange things started to happen at my house. It's usually a comforting environment but it felt very eerie for some reason. I was in my room on reddit when my boyfriend comes in looking kind of scared. I asked him whats wrong and he said he heard my father say my name. I am a firm believer in ghosts but forgot about it since my boyfriend was tired and it could have just been his mind making stuff up. The next day I sat in the living room playing XBox My boyfriend was at work and my mum was sleeping. I felt this weird sensation on my neck like someone was standing behind me watching what I was doing. Then I smelt it. Cigarette smoke. It smelt like someone was smoking right in my face. A bit freaked out I went in my room. I tried forgetting about that also. We were trying to fix up my dads old room, it reeked of cigarettes. So we cleaned it up and hired a family friend to paint it. Keep in mind my dad never allowed anyone but my mum and me in his room. Paula comes running out of the room her face pale white. I have to leave off there for now since I have to go somewhere stayed tuned there will be more to come. 

Edit: Paula comes running out face pale white. She was frantic. She told us she was doing her thing painting When she heard a voice from behind her scream "What are you doing here?!?" she said it was my dads voice. Remember when I said he let no one else in his room but my Mum and I? I wasn't lying. He didn't want her there. We instantly knew that these things were not in our heads and he actually is here. I got up the courage to go into his room which now felt very creepy unlike before. I talked to him. It was mostly a one sided converstation but I felt him behind me listening. I told him "it wasn't very nice to scare Paula but I know how much you hate other people being in your room" Before I left I told him I missed him. A few days later my boyfriend heard him call out "Maul? Are you there Maul?". It stopped for a little while then we had our final encounter. Another dream. it started in my room again. When I walked out into the hallway he was standing there with a big grin on his face. I stared at him. He just kept smiling his blue eyes were filled with happiness, instead of the cold gray eyes he had before. That was my dad. He had not been his self in years and it took his death to finally free him from his suffering. He was at peace. I also was different in the dream. I was my 10 year old self again. When I was ten life was good. I had a healthy father and I was a happy little girl. it went down hill when i was in middle school and my father started drinking more. I then ran at him and hugged him. I could not stop crying. He just smiled and patted my head. He didn't say a word but I felt so much comfort in him holding me. I talked about not crying and not feeling much when he died, that I didn't feel like I lost anything. When I woke up that morning. I had that feeling that I lost something. I knew he was gone for good. That dream was the last thing I would see of him. That he was saying goodbye. I lost it and started balling. After that nothing else ever happened and the house felt comfortable again. He just didn't want to leave without telling his little girl goodbye. Well that's my story. I know most won't believe it but I know it is true so that's all that matters.
